messages:
nina: Thinking about the Eval run timeline scrubber in Prompt Sets — current mock shows a tiny handle and auto-play, but a few concerns from usability testing. Notes below.

nina: TL;DR: make scrubber larger hit target, add keyboard controls (←/→, space play/pause), expose frame rate and snap-to-failure toggle, and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

omar: Agreed on hit target. On mobile the handle is basically impossible. Can we increase the draggable area to 24px? Also add a hover/active enlargement.

lucy: From design testing: people expect pauses to show captioned diffs (example: "Regressed on intent: price"), so we need a persistent caption area below the timeline, not transient tooltips.

praveen: Accessibility: keyboard nav is must-have. Also aria-live region for the caption updates so screen reader users hear the new failure summary when scrubbing. Suggest `aria-live=\"polite\"` for the caption box.

_design-bot: a11y-scan: animation duration 800ms, combined with autoplay may violate reduced-motion preferences. Flagged. Recommend honoring `prefers-reduced-motion`.

nina: Good catch. Add to decision: no autoplay if prefers-reduced-motion=true. Also reduce default animation to 200ms, but let advanced users slide to 500ms in settings.

omar: For keyboard controls: left/right arrow = step by frame, shift+arrow = jump 10 frames, space = play/pause, home/end = jump start/end. Also provide a small tooltip that lists shortcuts on hover of the handle.

lucy: UX question: should scrubbing snap to "failure frames" automatically? Users liked the 'snap-to-failure' prototype but worried about hiding nearby context. Proposal: toggle switch labeled 'Snap to failures (skip neutral frames)'. Default off.

praveen: Implementation note: we should expose the timeline frames in the DOM as buttons with `aria-pressed` for the current frame so each is focusable. That way assistive tech users can move by frame using tab or arrow keys.

nina: Caption copy: we tried a few phrasings — current copy "Regression: 3.2 delta — model hallucinated address" felt jargon-y. Proposed simpler: "Regression detected — hallucination about address (delta 3.2)." Thoughts?

lucy: Prefer starting with the human impact: "Fails to follow instructions: included an address (delta +3.2)". That helps product folks scan quickly.

pm-bot: note: this change affects export GIF captions and the scorecard CSV column `failure_summary`. Make sure localization folks get a heads up.

_design-bot: i18n-scan: caption phrases contain punctuation and parentheses which complicate some languages. Flag for localization team.

omar: On export: people want an auto-generated GIF/mp4 of the timeline for stakeholder decks. We can add a small export control in the scrubber toolbar: Export GIF (3s default) with caption burned in and optional high-contrast legend. Consider performance and server-side rendering.

praveen: Server-side render note: ensure we have the frame indexes and captions available in the export payload to avoid client-side differences. Also include a parameter `snapFailures=true/false` so exported video matches UI.

nina: Interaction copy: change button label from "Play" to "Play timeline"? Microcopy team suggested removing ambiguous nouns.

lucy: Also consider a compact mode: when there are >200 frames, collapse to compressed timeline with a slider for densification. Need visual affordance for compressed frames.

omar: Performance: use virtualized frames in the DOM for huge eval runs. Also throttle caption updates when scrubbing fast to avoid floods to aria-live. Use a 200ms debounce for screen reader announcements.

praveen: Action items: @omar add keyboard spec + 24px hit target to component PR, @praveen add aria-live & button semantics to accessibility ticket, @lucy update caption copy and design mock, @nina prototype export controls & prefers-reduced-motion behavior, @pm-bot notify i18n.

nina: Decision summary: enlarge handle, keyboard shortcuts (arrows/shift/home/end/space), caption area with aria-live, respects prefers-reduced-motion (no autoplay), optional snap-to-failure toggle (default off), export GIF with burned captions and snap toggle, and debounce announcements.

lucy: Small microcopy polish: use sentence-case caption start, e.g., "Fails to follow instructions: included an address (delta +3.2)". Also prefer 'delta +3.2' vs '3.2 delta'.

omar: I'll post a prototype demo link tomorrow and include a11y test notes.

praveen: Thanks  will add checklist items to the accessibility playbook.

nina: Thanks team — excited for this. Please tag me on the PR and i'll review the prototype.
